data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 demands a causal mechanism but its mechanism only explains why shared latent causes are hard to rule out; it never specifies the causal pathway by which a shared latent cause produces apparently uncorrelated failures simultaneously across independent operators. The problem asks what evidence would distinguish truly independent failure modes from merely uncorrelated ones, but SRC_001's mechanism does not supply any discriminating causal test — it asserts that absence of shared dependencies must be proven, which is an epistemic barrier, not a causal mechanism linking observed non-correlation to latent common-cause activation. Without specifying how the latent cause propagates and produces the observed failure signature (e.g., timing, scope, conditional activation pattern), there is no mechanism to falsify or confirm independence.
